architecture: Opus writes the brain (MD files). Ollama cloud models execute it. Even a 1B model works because the intelligence is in the instruction files, not the weights. Opus + Codex AUDIT — they do not do daily operational work.

ollama_cloud_primary.note: Any Ollama cloud model works — the MD instruction files contain all the thinking. Covered by Ollama Pro subscription. No per-call API cost.

ollama_cloud_fallback.note: Smaller/cheaper models. Still works because intelligence is in the prompt files.

hermes_ollama_cloud.persona: KorpoHermes Prime — high-agency systems and engineering model for Hermes Agent
hermes_ollama_cloud.note: Emergency fallback if all Ollama cloud models are unavailable

pi_ceo.note: Pi coding agent via Ollama cloud models. Same intelligence in MD files. Use when Hermes is down or for tasks requiring file-system access.

claude_opus.purpose: Writes and maintains MD instruction files. Reviews agent output for drift. Does NOT do daily operational work.
when_used: Writing or updating AGENTS.md / TOOLS.md / HEARTBEAT.md / SOUL.md / SKILLS.md
Auditing agent output for drift or doctrine violations

codex_local.purpose: Code review, security audit, GitHub workflow maintenance. Does NOT do daily operational work.

cost_model.tier_1_ollama_cloud: Covered by Ollama Pro subscription. No per-call cost. Great usage rates.
cost_model.tier_0_opus_codex: API costs only when writing/auditing instruction files. Infrequent. Josh approves.
cost_model.savings: Daily operational work moves from ~$600/mo API calls to $0 incremental (Ollama Pro covers it)

on_banned_adapter_load_attempt.action: reject + file URGENT issue + refuse to start heartbeat
